verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is not itself an agent. It is a consumer TOTP app with cloud sync, so an official MCP server that lets agents reach its codes is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers code sync, QR transfer, editing, Privacy Screen and HOTP/TOTP implementations, but nothing documents an MCP server, API or agent connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
